tasks.short: Apply specialist science to conservation objectives

steps.what: Inspect conditions and capture actual site observations
Check scientific sources and site data compatibility
Repeat specified layer comparisons and fixed scientific calculations
Interpret results and choose the conservation application
Write and save the actual scientific application note

tasks.design: Use a saved analytical workflow in the geographic information system represented by {OTHER} for scientist-specified comparisons. Keep actual field observations, method choice, ecological interpretation and the separate {DOCS} application note with the scientist.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeat layer comparisons can require repeated manual interaction.
tasks.enabler_now: Native saved analytical models can replay compatible comparisons.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing valid methods and translating site-specific results into an ecologically defensible action.
tasks.human_edge: Connect agronomy, soil and habitat constraints rather than treating a calculation as a conservation decision.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated analytical interaction, with scientific decisions unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: saved GIS models can repeat chosen calculations; site interpretation remains human.

assumptions: This scenario is an actual field-and-analysis application, including its assigned scientific note. Shares are provisional. Pure field-only applications need their own reweighted graph.

s1 captures real observations. Layer custodians provide parcel identifiers, coordinates, observation dates, units and classifications; s2 verifies these and records the chosen method. Missing data require manual field or source work, not fabricated inputs.

s2 includes method selection before s3; s3's chosen analytical method is produced there. Test native models first, retaining all compatibility checks. The 15 points are manual repeat interactions, excluding existing calculation runtime.
The actual record write and ordinary save are separated in s5, fully retained and ungated. No outside send or implementation order is included.
unknowns: Compatibility of parcel and soil layers
research_questions: Which applications contain repeated analytical interactions rather than entirely new scientific work?

incremental.description: Maintain layer mappings and known-result checks

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 15 analytical-interaction points less 1 upkeep gives 14. With incompatible soil classifications and parcel boundaries, only 3 points of already compatible comparisons replay; retain all repair and novel analysis, leaving 2 net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Plan soil and water conservation practices

steps.what: Collect and verify parcel, slope, soil and land-use facts
Choose feasible practices and specify applicable calculation methods
Calculate specified comparisons and prepare repeated plan tables
Write the plan rationale and implementation conditions

loop.input: candidate conservation plan and checked comparison tables
loop.check: Scientist checks causal claims, exceptions, quantities and omitted conditions against the selected plan
loop.stop: Missing method evidence or two failed drafts returns writing to the scientist
loop.why_not_simpler: Native headings and table links first; site-specific rationale needs limited prose restatement

steps.what: Validate feasibility and all plan claims and save the internal plan

tasks.design: Test native workbook tables and {DOCS} templates before building glue between them. Compute only scientist-specified comparisons and restate the selected plan in a bounded drafting loop; retain feasibility judgement and full source-to-plan validation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Comparison tables and plan prose are prepared manually after scientific choices.
tasks.enabler_now: Parameterised calculations plus source-bound plan drafting.
tasks.still_hard: Balancing erosion, water, habitat and workable land management under uncertain site conditions.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise a technically plausible practice that the land or land user cannot support.
tasks.altitude: Spend less time assembling comparison tables; retain conservation planning responsibility.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: specified spreadsheet calculations and source-based drafting can support conservation planning without selecting practices autonomously.

assumptions: Boundary ends at the checked internal plan; advice delivery and any contractor instruction are separate tasks. Shares are provisional, not measurements.

s1 produces parcel identifier, slope, soil class, observation date and current use through actual capture. s2 obtains land-user constraints and chooses method, factors, units and practice alternatives. Missing inputs require manual investigation.
The geographic information system in {OTHER} supports s2. Native formulas and templates are tested first. s3 counts manual table assembly and repeated interaction, never existing calculation runtime.
All scientific choices and complete final checking remain. The author's small same-system save stays inside s5 with no approval stage.
unknowns: Which methods and factors are locally applicable
Whether comparison tables already populate automatically
research_questions: Can one plan's tables be reproduced exactly from checked inputs and selected methods?

incremental.description: Maintain calculation factors, template links and drafting checks

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 15 comparison points plus 3 drafting points=18; less 1.2 upkeep gives 16.8. On steep parcels requiring bespoke terrace design, retain novel calculations and rationale: only 4 points of routine area comparisons and 0.8 of factual restatement disappear, giving 3.6 net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Read the current design and required inspection criteria
Inspect actual construction and capture observations and measurements
Judge conformity and determine unresolved design departures
Write the monitoring record with observations and findings
Check the complete monitoring record and save it

tasks.design: Configure the inspection record in {PROJECT} to retain the current project and design references. Keep actual site monitoring, conformity judgement and the separate factual write and complete check with the scientist; reference defaults remove repeated entry only.
tasks.previous_blocker: The same project and design references are entered into repeated monitoring records.
tasks.still_hard: Hidden construction conditions and whether deviations undermine conservation objectives.
tasks.human_edge: Interpret actual field evidence against design intent.
tasks.altitude: No change to inspection or acceptance authority.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: inspection-form defaults reuse project references but do not create observations or determine conformity.

assumptions: Boundary includes the actual monitoring record, not contractor remediation or a formal completion certificate. Provisional shares count focal labour only.

The design team provides project identifier, revision and inspection criteria before s1. s2 captures actual location, date, measurements and photographs; s3 supplies findings. Missing evidence is manually resolved.

Try the native inspection form first. Only two points of repeated project/revision entry disappear; full factual writing, judgement and ordinary save remain. No automatic instruction or external send is proposed.
unknowns: Whether the current inspection record already inherits project and design references
Who owns formal acceptance or corrective-work instructions
research_questions: Does the scientist repeat project references while writing actual findings?

incremental.description: Maintain inspection reference defaults after design revisions

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 20 times 10%=2 reference-entry points less 0.5 upkeep gives 1.5. With a bespoke design revision requiring manual reference checks, only 0.7 point of stable project identifiers is reused, giving 0.2 net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Advise land users on conservation alternatives

steps.what: Find and read applicable conservation guidance and existing plans
Discuss actual land problems, explain alternatives and capture agreed next steps
Write the actual advice and follow-up record
Check factual correspondence and save the advice record

tasks.design: Use native indexed guidance and plan filters in {DOCS} to reduce navigation before the actual advice conversation. Keep reading applicability, explaining alternatives and the separately counted advice record human; no automatic client advice is sent.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding the applicable approved guidance can involve repeated folder navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native document indexing and metadata filters.
tasks.still_hard: Understanding practical constraints, trust and site-specific consequences of alternatives.
tasks.human_edge: Listen to the land user and explain uncertainty in terms they can act on.
tasks.altitude: Slightly less navigation; advice responsibility stays unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native indexed guidance filters can reduce navigation while applicability and personal advice remain human.

assumptions: This boundary includes oral advice and its actual internal record; formal plan authorship is separately assessed and must not be counted twice. Shares are provisional.

Guidance owners supply current document identifiers, subject and applicability metadata. The scientist verifies these in s1; absent metadata requires manual search. s2 produces actual advice, conditions and next steps for s3, with capture counted there and in s2.
Test native filters first. Only 1.5 navigation points disappear. Full reading, live explanation, actual record writing, complete checking and ordinary ungated save remain.
If actual written advice is sent to the land user, add the real final-version check and separate send before estimating that boundary.
unknowns: Whether the assignment includes external written follow-up
research_questions: Can indexed guidance shorten actual navigation without replacing applicability reading?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 15 times 10%=1.5 navigation points less 0.4 upkeep gives 1.1. For an unusual drainage problem needing new sources, retain the search and reading; only 0.5 point of existing-plan navigation disappears, leaving 0.1 net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Retain scientific and land-user decisions while reducing verified repeated analysis and reference entry.
role.ambitious_version: Use verified recovered time for closer field interpretation and land-user follow-up.
